data.why: The real dataset lives in a sibling repo (KBarn_RFID) not bundled here, so hand-written RFID CSVs matching loader.py's exact schema (zone_label, uid, tag_no, timestamp; filenames must contain Pen{n}-lower/upper; uid must match 000C12XXXXXX; tag_no non-empty) let the app's own 'Load data' / upload path run end to end.

goals: load RFID co-location data and build the group association (SRI) network to see who bonds with whom
test whether an observed bond is real or chance using the datastream permutation test (preferred/avoided dyads)
track how group cohesion and modularity change over time as the colony disperses across pens
compute each mouse's 14-parameter sociality phenotype vector and cluster mice into social personality types
identify which mice are social hubs, brokers, or isolates using network centrality metrics
export computed matrices and phenotype tables as CSV for further analysis

review.summary: The tree describes the explorer accurately as a three-layer tool (group network, group sociality, individual phenotypes) built on SRI and permutation testing. Its phases, tasks and features are cut at a sensible grain, and every screen I sampled supports its node. It needs small fixes before filing: add a task for the unreachable phenotype-vs-behaviour link, add a help/glossary feature, separate the two centrality pickers, and clean up a few labels.
